title: fix(plugin-approvals): a revise-window recall on a batch item finds its batch run past the first 1000 parked runs
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DQALeiHN1aR44XyBgGozrec)_

domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1FQJt7HxgWZZ5cYz9

Fixes #28230

Clause-②: no (a recall on a store with more than 1000 parked runs now wakes its batch, as it already does below that; no schema, accept set, error code or result field changes)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：批量签批里，修改窗口内撤回某一项时，撤回改为在 `cancelRun` 之前按该项 run 自身的 `$parentRunId` / `$parentMapNode` 键读出它上面的批次 run（新增引擎成员 `AutomationEngine.suspendedMapParentOf`），不再扫 `listSuspendedRunsDurable()` 的 1000 行首页。
- 为什么改：实测 main（f40b777d）：两个副本共用一个 `ObjectStoreSuspendedRunStore`，批次之前已挂起 1000 条别的 run，在另一副本上撤回：该项被取消，批次 run 一直停在这一项上，第 2 项不开，`resumeError` 为空，什么都不说；998 条时一切正常。
- 风险与回滚：只换了“找批次”这一步；找到之后的恢复、只认内置 `map` 节点的检查、失败的告知方式都没变。新成员只读，两次按 id 读，存储读不出时抛错并照旧写进 `resumeError`。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts` 的 `suspendedMapParentOf`，与 `approval-service.ts` 里 `recall` 修改窗口分支和新私有方法 `batchAboveItem`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run src/batch-item-recall-resumes-batch.test.ts`（预期 9 passed，需先 build `@objectstack/service-automation`）与 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/suspended-map-parent-of.test.ts`（预期 5 passed）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位在 CI 绿后按落地授权落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts`: one new public read, `suspendedMapParentOf(itemRunId)`.** It loads the item run's suspension by id (the strict, store-authoritative loader `hasSuspendedRun` uses), reads the `$parentRunId` / `$parentMapNode` the `map` node launched it with, loads the parent's suspension by that id, and answers `{ runId, flowName, nodeId, correlation }` only while the parent is parked on `map:<itemRunId>` at the node the item names. Otherwise `undefined`. Two keyed reads, never a listing. It rejects when the store cannot be read, as `hasSuspendedRun` does. No other engine hunk; `run-resume.ts` and the store are untouched.
- **`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`.** `ApprovalResumeSurface` declares the member (optional). In `recall`'s revise-window branch the new private `batchAboveItem(runId)` reads it BEFORE `cancelRun`, because the cancel removes the item's suspension and the link with it. It never throws; a failed read is carried to `resumeBatchOfRecalledItem`, which now takes the parent it read instead of scanning `listSuspendedRunsDurable()`, and tells a failed lookup in `resumeError` after the cancel, as before. The built-in `map` check through `getFlow` and everything after it are unchanged.
- **Tests.** `suspended-map-parent-of.test.ts` (new, service-automation) pins the engine member; `batch-item-recall-resumes-batch.test.ts` (plugin-approvals) gains a `#28230` block over two replicas and one `ObjectStoreSuspendedRunStore`. Its existing wiring moved into a `wireReplica` helper; #28228's five cells are unchanged and green. No new engine double: the block reuses the file's already-pinned one, so `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` is untouched.
- **`.changeset/28230-batch-recall-past-first-page.md`.** `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` and `@objectstack/service-automation`, patch.

## Why

### Before (measured at `origin/main` `f40b777d`)

Replicas `a` and `b` share one `ObjectStoreSuspendedRunStore` and one table set. N `paused` rows of another flow are stored first. The batch (`map` over two `task_signoff` items) is launched on `a`, item 1 is sent back on `a`, and the submitter recalls item 1 on `b`.

| | N = 1000, before | N = 998, before | N = 1000, after |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| batch on `b.listSuspendedRunsDurable()` | no | yes | no (no longer read) |
| item 1's run | `cancelled` | `cancelled` | `cancelled` |
| item 2's request | none: the batch stays parked on item 1 | `pending` | `pending` |
| recall answer | `resumed: false`, no `resumeError` | `resumed: false`, no `resumeError` | `resumed: false`, no `resumeError` |
| after item 2 is approved | (never reached) | marker in slot 1, `count` 1 | marker in slot 1, `count` 1, batch `completed` |

The listing reads one 1000-row page of `paused` rows in driver order, and a process adds only what it parked itself. So the batch is missed exactly when another process (a replica, or this one before a restart) parked it behind more than 1000 runs.

### Why this path

Triage 6531219559 / 6532374421 ruled 「a correlation-keyed lookup instead of a full listing」. The item run already carries its batch: `map-node.ts` launches every item with `$parentRunId` and `$parentMapNode`. Reading that before the cancel needs no store change, no schema change and no new code. The parked-on-this-item check guards one real shape: a `subflow` inside a `map` item inherits the item's `$parentMapNode` through the spread context, so its `$parentRunId` names the item run, which is parked at a `subflow` node, not the map (pinned).

## Tests

`suspended-map-parent-of.test.ts` (5 cells): a `map` item answers its batch, also from a second engine over the same store with nothing in memory; CONTROL a `subflow` child, a `subflow` nested in a `map` item, an item whose batch has moved on, a top-level run and an unknown id answer `undefined`.

`batch-item-recall-resumes-batch.test.ts`, `#28230` block (4 cells):

1. the batch past the first page resumes, item 1's slot holds #28176's `cancelled` marker, `count` 1, the batch completes (red on `main`: no request opens for item 2);
2. CONTROL: a batch within the first page behaves as before;
3. CONTROL: a recall with no batch above it, past the first page, behaves as before, and the batch beside it stays parked on its item;
4. CONTROL: a parent the engine answers (a home-grown fan-out that writes the same linkage) but parked at a node other than the built-in `map` is left alone.

Ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty:

| Ablation | Red |
|:---|:---|
| A1: `batchAboveItem` answers no parent | #28183 cell 1, #28230 cells 1 and 2 |
| A2: the batch is read after `cancelRun` | #28183 cell 1, #28230 cells 1 and 2 |
| A3: drop the built-in `map` node check | #28230 cell 4 |
| A4: engine member drops the parked-on-this-item check | engine cells 2, 3, 4 |

(A5, dropping the `typeof parentRunId` check, stayed green: a missing id loads no suspension, so it answers `undefined` either way. It is the type narrowing the next read needs, not a guard.)

## Verification

Head `776907f9`, after a whole-tree `turbo run build`, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and fetching the teardown self-test's pinned commit.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation run test`: 234 files, 2952 passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals run test`: 106 files, 1361 passed. Both packages' `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 64 families, all exit 0 (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` exited 3 before the whole-tree build and 0 after it). `--ran`: 64 derived, 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check:engine-double-contract` and `check:objectql-double-limit` are green with no ledger edit.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0. `check-commit-card-trailers --range origin/main..HEAD`: exit 0.

## Out of scope

- None filed. Probed while pinning: a `subflow` inside a `map` item inherits the item's `$parentMapNode`, but on `main` the nested chain still completes into the item run and the batch moves on, so it is not a defect. The engine member's parked-on-this-item check keeps it from answering that shape.
- `listSuspendedRunsDurable` still reads one 1000-row page for its other caller, the restored-continuation proof in `approval-service.ts`, which refuses on an absent entry (a retry, not a silent strand). Not this card's.
